tabs.title: Requests - last 24 hours
tabs.content:
union
(
    Requests_dataflow_realtime
    | extend IngestionPath = "Dataflow"
),
(
    requestsPowerQueryRealTime
    | extend IngestionPath = "Power Query"
)
| where timestamp >= ago(24h)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(tolower(success) == "false"),
    AverageDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2)
    by bin(timestamp, 5m), IngestionPath
| order by timestamp asc
